import os,glob,re,json,math
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()
inp=G['Demo pair 1 input']; out=G['Demo pair 1 output']
bg_in=3
# Find connected components by color in input
def components(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    vis=[[False]*w for _ in range(h)]
    comps=[]
    from collections import deque
    for i in range(h):
        for j in range(w):
            c=grid[i][j]
            if c!=3 and not vis[i][j]:
                color=c
                q=((i,j),(color))
                comp=set()
                while q:
                    ((r,cv),cc)=q.pop()
                    if cv<0 or cv>=h or c<0 or c>=w or vis[r][c] or grid[r][c]!=color:
                        continue
                    vis[r][c]=True
                    comp.add((r,c))
                    for dr,dc in ((1,0),( -1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                        q.append(((r+dr,c+dc),cc))
                comps.append(comp)
    return comps
in_comps = components(inp)
out_comps = components(out)
print('Input components count:', len(in_comps))
for ci,comp in enumerate(in_comps):
    vals=set(inp[r][c] for (r,c) in comp)

import os,glob,re,json,numpy as np,collections, re, glob, itertools

    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):

        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G

import os,glob,re,sys,json
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()
# analyze demo6 carefully: find objects by color connected components (non-background, non-noise?)
# Noise 9 removed entirely; output only 1s. Input 1 cells count and positions vs output 1s.
def comp(grid, color):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0]); seen=[[False]*w for _ in range(h)]
    res=[]
    for y in range(h):
        for x in range(w):
            if seen[y][x]: continue
            v=grid[y][x]; ok=(v==color)
            if not ok: continue
            Q=[(y,x)]; seen[y][x]=True; blk=[(y,x)]
            while Q:
                yy,xx=Q.pop(0); for dy,dx in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                    ny,nx=yy+dy,xx+dx
                    if 0<=ny<h and 0<=nx<w and not seen[ny][nx] and grid[ny][nx]==v:
                        seen[ny][nx]=True; Q.append((ny,nx)); blk.append((ny,nx))
            res.append(blk)
    return res

        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()
# analyze demo6: connected components of 1s, their bboxes
def comp(grid, color):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0]); seen=[[False]*w for _ in range(h)]
    res=[]
    for y in range(h):
        for x in range(w):
            if seen[y][x]: continue
            v=grid[y][x]
            if not (v==color): continue
            Q=[(y,x)]; seen[y][x]=True; blk=[(y,x)]
            while Q:
                yy,xx=Q.pop(0); for dy,dx in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):

                    if 0<=ny<h and 0<=nx<w and not seen[ny][nx] and grid[ny][nx]==v:
                        seen[ny][nx]=True; Q.append((ny,nx)); blk.append((ny,nx))
            res.append(blk)
    return res
